title: 声音不必锁住
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE original full-bleed vertical 9:16 watercolor story illustration for one locked narration shot. Use every input according to its explicitly labelled role; preserve existing named identities, not just species. Input 1: canonical identity reference for 皮皮 (pipi); preserve this character exactly. Input 2: Pipi clothing sheet only; follow the exact outfit specified below. Input 3: visual continuity reference. Input 4: visual continuity reference.
Visible characters: 皮皮 (pipi). Exact total number of visible characters: 1. Do not draw extra background animals. Standing body-height ratios (not ear or tail tips): 皮皮 1.0. Pipi wears ONLY the LEFT daytime outfit from the wardrobe sheet: dusty blue overalls, oatmeal shirt, blue cloth shoes, small yellow backpack. No star cap in daytime. Scene continuity: 皮皮卧室书桌前，打开的松木盒与红叶。
The SINGLE visual moment and framing: 皮皮看着盒中的红叶，明白声音不需要锁在木盒里。
Emotional performance for this exact beat: 安稳、理解，神情明亮而克制。
Mandatory pose/prop state (overrides neutral model-sheet poses): 不画具象心形/大脑或发光魔法；声音不实体化。
Style: hand-painted gentle watercolor on fine warm paper, muted natural hues, soft edges and rounded shapes, quiet storybook mood, no glossy 3D or photorealism. Daylight scenes use soft greens and warm daylight, not bedroom amber tint. Night scenes use soft warm lamplight and muted gray-blue windows. Composition: full-bleed vertical 9:16. Keep all important faces, hands, feet, biscuits, fabric folds and other story actions in the upper 68% of the image. Bottom 32% is low-detail negative space for later subtitles, with no crucial objects there. Make the specified story state visually understandable. Text: NONE. No words, labels, subtitles, numbers, logos, watermark, speech bubbles, panels, frames or collage. Do not reproduce model sheets, multiple versions of a character, or wardrobe lineups. Each named character appears exactly once. This is a new single coherent scene, not a copy of the references. No motion streaks or implied camera zoom. Never turn a metaphor into a real transformation: yellow blankets remain fabric, imagined grassy softness is not actual grass growing in bed. No new story events. Continuity-specific locks: At this story point, the red leaf is the only object inside the wooden box; never add other collected sounds or objects to it. Do not depict sound as visible letters, music notes, sound waves, glowing objects, or captured material. Reference roles: Input 1 is the canonical identity reference for pipi; preserve this exact character. Input 2 shows Pipi's day and sleep outfits; use only the outfit specified in the prompt. Input 3: This is the same single pale honey-pine lidded box; preserve its rounded corners and small scale. Input 4: This is the same single red autumn leaf from Pipi and Rongrong’s daytime walk.Light and time lock: This exact scene occurs at night in the bedroom. Show a dark blue night sky outside the window, warm interior lamplight and no daylight.
